[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[b]Pierre's Board Quests[/b]
Turn the bulletin board outside Pierre's shop into your own hiring hall. Instead of waiting for the Help Wanted board to offer something useful, post the request yourself: pick an item from your inventory, set the quantity, and name your price. Villagers may take the job — and they settle up by mail.
[b]How it works[/b]
Walk up to the board and press the interact key. A menu offers three choices: post a request, review the requests you've posted, or open the vanilla board, which behaves exactly as before.
Choose an item, a quantity from 1 to 999, and a reward between 1× and 10× the base price (
[/color]
[code]sellToStorePrice × quantity[/code][color=#D4D4D8]). The form shows your accept chance in real time. The reward is paid up front; the item is never taken from your inventory.
[b]The wait[/b]
Each night, every villager in the valley gets a chance to accept. Generous rewards attract takers far more reliably — roughly 5% at minimum price, near-certain at ten times. Three nights without a taker, and Lewis writes to return your deposit in full.
Once someone accepts, they get two days. Success depends on how hard the item is to obtain and how many you asked for, legendary fish and out-of-season crops are notably tougher. On the settlement night a letter arrives: the goods attached, or your gold back.
[b]Details[/b]
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]47 villagers write in their own voice — Abigail brags about the mines, Clint stumbles over his words, Sophia stutters.[/color][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Modded NPCs fall back to a neutral template, so nothing ever renders blank.[/color][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Price bounds, acceptance curve, difficulty weights and refund rules are all adjustable through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Full English and Simplified Chinese localization. No dependencies beyond SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Single-player is fully supported; in multiplayer only the host can use the board.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Built for Stardew Valley 1.6 (SMAPI 4). Tested alongside Stardew Valley Expanded.[b]Pierre's Board Quests[/b]
